findings: The only noninitialization selectedTakeId assignment is selectNewsTake, after available-audio validation and through serialized change.
Library creation initializes null; load migrations preserve the saved field through object spread. Completion and sidecar recovery append artifacts and update requests, without assigning selection.

The only renderer invocation is PreparedTakes selection mutation, called by explicit chooseTake handlers on Use this take and Clear selection. Synchronous ownership/global mutation guards reject overlap.
Stations editing and mismatch indicators read the selected take; script replacement/load actions alter the editable draft rather than invoke selection.
Main IPC delegates explicitly; sign-out cancels preparation and updates connection/workflow state without selecting or clearing a take.
